# Appendix M. Manuscript parameter export (single source of truth)

Every PSD, rescaling and risk number quoted in the Savoca et al. manuscript and SI is written here to `data_output/psd_rescaling_params.json` (and a flat CSV), at full precision, from the objects computed above. Rounding happens only in the manuscript-generation step. W1 values use the resolved rescaling basis: concentrations restricted to the fixed fit window, rescaled with each river's own fixed-window MLE slope (pooled slope, two-segment model and the former C-PSD slopes as sensitivities). W2 is the reported 50–500 µm concentration.

```{r manuscript-params-export}
.nb <- function(f) tryCatch(stats::nobs(f$fit), error = function(e) NA_integer_)
fit_row <- function(f) list(a_cum = f$a_cpsd, a_cum_SE = f$se_a_cpsd, a_diff = f$a_psd, a_diff_SE = f$se_a_psd,
                            CI95_a_diff = f$a_psd + c(-1.96, 1.96) * f$se_a_psd, R2 = f$r2, n_bins = .nb(f),
                            window_LOD_um = c(f$lower_lod_um, f$upper_lod_um),
                            estimator = f$estimator %||% "cpsd", n_window = f$n_window %||% NA_real_,
                            a_diff_cpsd = f$cpsd$a_psd %||% NA_real_, a_diff_SE_cpsd = f$cpsd$se_a_psd %||% NA_real_,
                            window_cpsd_um = c(f$cpsd$lower_lod_um %||% NA_real_, f$cpsd$upper_lod_um %||% NA_real_))
pw_row <- dplyr::filter(critical_piecewise_tbl, Matrix == "River water")
qsum <- function(x) list(median_L = stats::median(x), q25_L = stats::quantile(x, 0.25, names = FALSE),
                        q75_L = stats::quantile(x, 0.75, names = FALSE), mean_L = mean(x), n = length(x))
rs_row <- function(x, erm) { r <- dplyr::filter(x, ERM == erm, HCx == 5); list(RQ_p50 = r$RQ_p50, RQ_p95 = r$RQ_p95, P_exceed = r$P_exceed) }

psd_params <- list(
  meta = list(run_budget = run_budget, n_boot = n_boot, n_mc = n_mc, slope_application = slope_application,
              slope_structural_sd = slope_structural_sd, monitoring_file = basename(monitoring_file),
              slope_estimator = slope_estimator, headline_length_window_um = headline_length_window,
              pssdplusplus_version = as.character(packageVersion("PSSDplusplus")),
              rendered = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")),
  monitoring = as.list(river_conc_summary),
  pooled = fit_row(cpsd_fit_all),
  fragment = fit_row(cpsd_fit_frag),
  fiber = fit_row(cpsd_fit_fiber),
  ocean = list(all = fit_row(cpsd_fit_ocean_all), fragment = fit_row(cpsd_fit_ocean_frag), fiber = fit_row(cpsd_fit_ocean_fiber)),
  sand = list(all = fit_row(cpsd_fit_sed_all), fragment = fit_row(cpsd_fit_sed_frag), fiber = fit_row(cpsd_fit_sed_fiber)),
  hazard_alignment_slopes = list(river_area = fit_row(cpsd_fit_area), river_volume = fit_row(cpsd_fit_volume),
                                 ocean_area = fit_row(cpsd_fit_area_ocean), ocean_volume = fit_row(cpsd_fit_volume_ocean),
                                 sand_area = fit_row(cpsd_fit_area_sed), sand_volume = fit_row(cpsd_fit_volume_sed)),
  ocean_heterogeneity = if (!is.null(ocean_slope_heterogeneity)) ocean_slope_heterogeneity[c("Q", "df", "p_value", "i2", "weighted_mean")] else NULL,
  by_river = lapply(cpsd_fits_by_loc, fit_row),
  heterogeneity = river_slope_heterogeneity[c("Q", "df", "p_value", "i2", "weighted_mean")],
  two_segment = list(breakpoint_um = pw_row$piecewise_break_um,
                     a_fine_cum = pw_row$piecewise_low_a_cpsd, a_coarse_cum = pw_row$piecewise_high_a_cpsd,
                     a_fine_diff = pw_row$piecewise_low_a_cpsd - 1, a_coarse_diff = pw_row$piecewise_high_a_cpsd - 1,
                     dAIC = pw_row$piecewise_delta_aic),
  # Rescaling on the resolved basis: concentrations restricted to each C-PSD
  # window (Section 4.2.2), CF from that same window to 1-5000 um.
  rescaling = list(
    basis = if (concentration_basis == "particle_rebuild")
      "Concentration in the headline fit window (100-500 um) rebuilt from QC-passing particle rows x summary aliquot factor (extrap_count/count) / analysed volume; CF from the same window to 1-5000 um with the headline fixed-window MLE slope. FLAG: rebuild basis needs data-owner confirmation before publication."
      else "C-PSD-window concentration (reported 50-500 um concentration x in-window particle fraction); CF from the same window to 1-5000 um",
    concentration_basis = concentration_basis,
    n_samples_river_used = nrow(monitoring),
    river_excluded_no_particle_data = I(river_excluded_no_particles),
    ocean_excluded_no_particle_data = I(ocean_excluded_no_particles),
    sand_excluded_no_particle_data = I(sed_excluded_no_particles),
    n_nondetect_river_window = sum(monitoring$C_measured_pL == 0),
    C_rebuilt_50_500_river = if (concentration_basis == "particle_rebuild") qsum(monitoring$C_rebuilt_reported_window) else NULL,
    C_W2_reported = qsum(monitoring$C_reported_pL),
    C_lod_window_river = qsum(monitoring$C_measured_pL),
    lod_fraction_median = stats::median(monitoring$lod_particle_fraction),
    windows_by_river = lapply(split(river_corr$L_meas_by_group, river_corr$L_meas_by_group$group), function(w) c(w$L_meas_min, w$L_meas_max)),
    CF_by_river = lapply(combined_cf_by_river, function(x) stats::quantile(x, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), names = FALSE)),
    CF_pooled = stats::quantile(combined_cf_pooled, c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), names = FALSE),
    CF_pooled_window = c(L_meas_min_use, L_meas_max_use),
    CF_two = pw_river$cf_piecewise,
    C_W1_river = qsum(C_sample_median$C_corr_med),
    C_W1_pooled = qsum(C_sample_median_pooled$C_corr_med),
    C_W1_two = qsum(monitoring_pooled_scope$C_measured_pL * pw_river$cf_piecewise)),
  risk_headline = list(food_dilution_HC5 = rs_row(risk_summary, "Food Dilution"),
                       tissue_translocation_HC5 = rs_row(risk_summary, "Tissue Translocation")),
  risk_by_river = if (!is.null(risk_summary_by_river)) lapply(split(risk_summary_by_river, risk_summary_by_river$river), function(x)
    list(food_dilution_HC5 = rs_row(x, "Food Dilution"), tissue_translocation_HC5 = rs_row(x, "Tissue Translocation"))) else NULL,
  risk_pooled_slope = list(food_dilution_HC5 = rs_row(risk_summary_pooled, "Food Dilution"),
                           tissue_translocation_HC5 = rs_row(risk_summary_pooled, "Tissue Translocation")),
  eed_river_q50_median_L = stats::median(eed_boot$q50)
)
# Pooled single-slope W1 over pooled two-segment W1 (same anchor and slope source;
# Part C fix -- previously divided the river-specific W1 by the pooled two-segment W1).
psd_params$rescaling$ratio_W1_pooled_over_two <- psd_params$rescaling$C_W1_pooled$median_L / psd_params$rescaling$C_W1_two$median_L
psd_params$particle_qc <- list(
  rule = "acc_analy_conf == 'confident' & bad_spectra == FALSE (bad_spectra TRUE <=> max_cor_val <= 0.66)",
  polarity_fixed = "2026-10-15 (previously kept bad_spectra == TRUE)",
  waterfall = lapply(split(particle_qc_waterfall_tbl, particle_qc_waterfall_tbl$matrix), function(x) as.list(stats::setNames(x$n, x$stage))),
  reconciliation = lapply(split(particle_qc_recon_summary, particle_qc_recon_summary$matrix), function(x) as.list(x[, -1])),
  summary_count_river = sum(particle_qc_recon_tbl$summ_count[particle_qc_recon_tbl$matrix == "River water"]),
  qc_rows_river = nrow(raw_particles_river))
if (exists("anchor_params")) psd_params$anchor_shape <- anchor_params
if (exists("mpsb_params")) psd_params$mpsizebase <- mpsb_params
if (exists("slope_method_params")) psd_params$slope_methods <- slope_method_params

jsonlite::write_json(psd_params, "data_output/psd_rescaling_params.json", auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA, pretty = TRUE)
flat <- unlist(psd_params)
utils::write.csv(data.frame(key = names(flat), value = unname(flat)), "data_output/psd_rescaling_params.csv", row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo()), "data_output/session_info.txt")
cat("Exported", length(flat), "values to data_output/psd_rescaling_params.json\n")
```
